hints.title: Baseline Shortest Path Inspection
hints.text: First calculate the shortest distance when all modifiable -1 edges are set to weight 1, and also when they are set to a very large weight.

hints.title: Impossibility Thresholds
hints.text: If the shortest distance with all -1 edges set to 1 exceeds target, or with all -1 edges set to infinity is less than target, achieving target is impossible.

hints.title: Iterative Edge Tuning
hints.text: Run a shortest path search from destination to all nodes, then adjust each -1 edge along the source-destination path so the cumulative distance equals target.

hints.title: Two-Pass Dijkstra Modification Implementation

complexity.notes: Shortest path re-evaluation after adjusting each modifiable edge.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Continuous optimization across multi-dimensional weight space is intractable without shortest path duality.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that setting -1 edges to 1 gives the lower bound and uses Dijkstra to tune weights sequentially.
